# Learn Online English Speaking

> > A comprehensive language learning blog covering study techniques, app reviews, and personal journeys for learners of French, Russian, Chinese, Japanese, and other languages.

This blog aggregates practical advice, community discussions, and resource reviews for language learners at all levels. Content focuses on overcoming common challenges like speaking anxiety, heritage language learning, and advancing through CEFR levels (B1 to B2), with frequent mentions of popular tools like Duolingo, HelloTalk, and immersion techniques.

## Key Topics

- Language Learning Strategies
- French Learning
- CEFR Levels (B1, B2)
- Duolingo
- HelloTalk
- Heritage Language Learning
- Vocabulary Acquisition
- Speaking Practice & Confidence
- Language Learning Apps
- Immersion Techniques
- Russian, Chinese, Japanese
- Pronunciation & Accent
- Language Learning Journey
- Script Learning (Cyrillic, Arabic, Chinese)

## Learning Techniques & Methods

- [Implement shadowing while you read](https://learnonlineenglishspeaking.blogspot.com/2025/07/implement-shadowing-while-you-read.html): Shadowing technique guide for reading with audiobooks in Russian/Persian
- [This simple trick will help you to learn and practice any script](https://learnonlineenglishspeaking.blogspot.com/2025/08/this-simple-trick-will-help-you-to.html): Google Maps trick for learning Cyrillic, Arabic, Chinese scripts
- [Improve your speaking vocabulary](https://learnonlineenglishspeaking.blogspot.com/2026/03/improve-your-speaking-vocabulary.html): Fluency prompts and techniques to expand active speaking vocabulary
- [Tips on being scared to speak a language due to an accent or fear of judgement?](https://learnonlineenglishspeaking.blogspot.com/2025/08/tips-on-being-scared-to-speak-language.html): Overcoming speaking anxiety and accent fear in language learning
- [Fellow B1 levelled learners, what does your daily study plan to get to B2 look like?](https://learnonlineenglishspeaking.blogspot.com/2025/07/fellow-b1-levelled-learners-what-does.html): Study plan strategies for advancing from B1 to B2 language level
- [Looking to learn a new language with hearing loss](https://learnonlineenglishspeaking.blogspot.com/2025/10/looking-to-learn-new-language-with.html): Language learning accessibility strategies for hearing loss learners

## Personal Learning Journeys & Challenges

- [My 2025 learning journey, and 2026 goal](https://learnonlineenglishspeaking.blogspot.com/2026/01/my-2025-learning-journey-and-2026-goal.html): Personal French learning journey with Duolingo and 2026 goals in Québec
- [What are your biggest weaknesses and what do you do to get better at them?](https://learnonlineenglishspeaking.blogspot.com/2025/12/what-are-your-biggest-weaknesses-and.html): Discussion on language learning weaknesses and improvement strategies
- [After 20 years, I did it, the ALVEOLAR TRILL!](https://learnonlineenglishspeaking.blogspot.com/2026/02/after-20-years-i-did-it-alveolar-trill.html): Success story mastering rolled R pronunciation after 20 years
- [I'm frustrated with someone who speaks the language I want to speak.](https://learnonlineenglishspeaking.blogspot.com/2025/07/im-frustrated-with-someone-who-speaks.html): Spanish learning frustration and beginner motivation challenges
- [How do you measure your vocabulary progress when reading online content?](https://learnonlineenglishspeaking.blogspot.com/2026/02/how-do-you-measure-your-vocabulary.html): Methods for tracking vocabulary acquisition from online reading

## Heritage Language & Cultural Identity

- [My parents not teaching me their language made me too embarassed to even try speaking](https://learnonlineenglishspeaking.blogspot.com/2025/09/my-parents-not-teaching-me-their.html): Heritage language learning challenges and cultural identity struggles
- [Are you annoyed that your immigrant parents didn't teach you their language?](https://learnonlineenglishspeaking.blogspot.com/2025/10/are-you-annoyed-that-your-immigrant.html): Discussion on immigrant parents and heritage language teaching
- [Young creators use social media to teach Assyrian](https://learnonlineenglishspeaking.blogspot.com/2025/11/young-creators-use-social-media-to.html): Social media creators teaching endangered Assyrian language online
